name: 92653 · Laguna Hills, CA
findings: ZIP 92653 (Laguna Hills) has 189 nonprofit organizations. 72 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92653 (Laguna Hills) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92653 (Laguna Hills) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 7 health care organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
